mapper.select: SELECT A.CD as cd , A.KR_NM as krNm , A.EN_NM as enNm , A.DESCRIPTION as description , A.ISSUE_CNTRY_NM as issueCntryNm , B.PRICE as price , B.PRICE_DT as priceDt , B.MARKET_CAP as marketCap , A.USE_YN as useYn FROM TB_COIN_INFO A INNER JOIN TB_COIN_DETAIL B ON B.CD = A.CD WHERE 1=1 AND B.PRICE_DT = ( SELECT MAX(SUB.PRICE_DT) FROM TB_COIN_DETAIL SUB WHERE SUB.CD = A.CD )

SELECT A.CD as cd , A.PRICE as price , A.PRICE_DT as priceDt , A.MARKET_CAP as marketCap , A.ETC as etc
FROM TB_COIN_DETAIL A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CD = #{cd} ORDER BY cd asc , price_dt DESC
